statements.notes:
100% pure wild caught
From wild caught, cold water fish of the North Atlantic

Wild Caught
Antler Farms Marine Collagen is 100% pure, hydrolyzed collagen sourced from wild caught, cold water fish. Our marine collagen is derived from Pacific Snapper from the deep blue waters of the North Atlantic Ocean.

Pure & Clean
Using an enzymatic hydrolyzation process, collagen peptides are isolated, purified and concentrated to create a marine collagen that is pure and clean. Antler Farms Marine Collagen is flavorless and odorless.
Highly Bioavailable
Antler Farms Marine Collagen is optimized molecularly to be easily digested. Our collagen is highly bioavailable, rapidly absorbed and perfectly soluble in hot or cold liquids.
These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease.

statements.type: Precautions re: Pregnant or Nursing or Prescription Medications
statements.notes: Please consult your physician prior to use if you have any medical conditions, are taking any medications, or are pregnant or nursing.
Do not use if under 18 years old. Keep out of reach of children.
Suggested use: Mix one serving with 8-16 ounces of water, juice or your favorite smoothie.
Store in a dry, cool space, tightly sealed.
